_comment: SNAPSHOT of the Eurostat Comext query the CBAM money model rests on. Written by hand,
re-runnable: each row carries the exact request URL that produced it, so the figure can
be reproduced or refreshed without reconstructing the query.
Extra-EU imports into EU27, annual, quantity in 100 kg as Comext reports it. The Mt
conversion is arithmetic (value_100kg / 1e7) and is recorded here rather than done in the
model, so that the number the parameter file states is the number this file shows.
2025 is the last full year. Volumes rose about 23% on 2024 across HS 2523, which is the
kind of movement worth knowing before it is read as a trend: the CBAM definitive period
began on 1 January 2026, and importers had an obvious reason to bring goods in first.
source: Eurostat Comext, dataset ds-045409 (EU trade since 1988 by HS2-4-6 and CN8)
